requirements.normative_requirement: Release 0.1 accepts only a clean Git repository at one exact committed tree.
requirements.primary_verification: Dirty tracked, staged, untracked, ignored, conflicted, unborn, and non-Git source corpus.

requirements.normative_requirement: The source identity records repository identity, exact commit, tree digest, path profile, and pre/post snapshot observations.
requirements.primary_verification: Mutate refs or worktree during snapshot and prove import aborts before lease acquisition.

requirements.normative_requirement: Source snapshot construction uses fixed Git plumbing and invokes no clone transport, hook, filter, LFS, submodule, credential helper, or external diff.
requirements.primary_verification: Malicious hooks, attributes, filters, helpers, LFS config, and transport config are installed and never invoked.

requirements.threat_or_failure: Nested repository authority and network expansion
requirements.primary_verification: Tree containing mode 160000 is rejected with a typed reason.

requirements.normative_requirement: Only the Release 0.1 path and inode profile is importable; unsupported names, modes, and objects fail closed.
requirements.threat_or_failure: Parser/UI confusion and unsafe special files
requirements.primary_verification: Corpus with non-UTF-8, non-NFC, newline, control characters, devices, FIFOs, sockets, hardlinks, and unsupported symlinks.

requirements.normative_requirement: Every imported blob and manifest is content-addressed and reverified by the guest agent before materialization.
requirements.primary_verification: Flip manifest and blob bytes in transit and prove materialization fails before execution.

requirements.normative_requirement: Release 0.1 imports only the selected tree, not repository history or shared object storage.
requirements.threat_or_failure: Historical secret exposure and shared-object corruption
requirements.primary_verification: Verify guest object set contains only synthetic repository objects and imported tree content.
